# Emad Alhamou

> Personal site of Emad Alhamou, a Syrian-German founder and product builder based in Germany. He builds Nadhif, TakeCar, Shfli, and Arab Solutions: products for Mac maintenance and security, mobility, marketplaces, and AI-powered customer support in emerging markets. The site is in Arabic, English and German (picked from the browser language, switchable in the footer).

## Main page

- [hamou.de](https://hamou.de/): About Emad, his companies, open-source tools, articles, experience, and contact.

## Products

- [TakeCar](https://takecarapp.com): Syrian mobility platform.
- [Arab Solutions](https://omysyria.com/ar): AI customer support platform that brings knowledge and channels into one place.
- [Shfli](https://www.shfli.com/?section=items): Platform for buying, selling, and auctions.
- [Nadhif](https://nadhif.hamou.de/): Mac cleaner with developer tools and a vulnerability scanner that helps protect websites and servers from hackers, built by the Alhamou team (in development since September 2026).

<!-- articles:start -->
## Articles

Articles are static pages in English, German and Arabic (where a translation exists). Add index.md to an article URL for a plain Markdown copy. All English articles in one file: [llms-full.txt](https://hamou.de/llms-full.txt).

- [Nadhif: clean your Mac with developer tools and protect your website and server from hackers](https://hamou.de/articles/nadhif/index.md): Nadhif is a Mac cleaner with developer tools that also tests your websites and servers for vulnerabilities, so you can fix weak spots before hackers find them. Also in [Deutsch](https://hamou.de/de/articles/nadhif/index.md) and [العربية](https://hamou.de/ar/articles/nadhif/index.md).
